game_objects.description: List all GameObjects in the active world

class_filter.description: Only objects that have this component class

game_object.description: Full detail on a single GameObject

include_fields.description: Fields to include. Field names should be the same as reflected DProperty names in GameObject. When empty, includes all fields

hierarchy.description: Parent-child tree of the active world (names + IDs only)

root_object_id.description: Subtree root. Omit for entire world.

component.description: Full detail on a single component

include_fields.description: Fields to include per object. Field names should be the same as reflected DProperty names in this component. When empty, includes all fields

components_on_object.description: All components attached to a GameObject

find_by_property.description: Find objects/components where a property matches a value

value.description: Property value to match (JSON scalar, array, or object per reflected property type)

get_position.description: Position of a SceneComponent in local or world space

object_id.description: SceneComponent id, or a GameObject id to read its root SceneComponent

get_rotation.description: Rotation of a SceneComponent in local or world space, as both quaternion and euler angles

object_id.description: SceneComponent id, or a GameObject id to read its root SceneComponent

returns.euler: [x,y,z] in degrees; local space returns the stored angles verbatim (may exceed +/-180), world space is derived from the world quaternion

get_scale.description: Scale of a SceneComponent in local or world space

object_id.description: SceneComponent id, or a GameObject id to read its root SceneComponent

DeleteGameObject.description: Delete a GameObject and all its components

CreateComponent.description: Add a component to a GameObject

SetPosition.description: Animate or immediately set a SceneComponent's position. Writes m_localPosition; world space is converted through the parent's inverse world transform
SetPosition.expects_result_note: Returns as soon as the tween starts when duration_seconds > 0; the undo entry is committed when the animation completes

duration_seconds.description: Tween duration in seconds. Defaults to 1.0 (animated); <= 0 = immediate

SetRotation.description: Animate or immediately set a SceneComponent's rotation. A local-space euler value is written to m_localEulerAngles verbatim; everything else writes m_localRotation
SetRotation.expects_result_note: Returns as soon as the tween starts when duration_seconds > 0; the undo entry is committed when the animation completes

value.description: [x,y,z,w] quaternion or [x,y,z] euler angles in DEGREES

duration_seconds.description: Tween duration in seconds. Defaults to 1.0 (animated); <= 0 = immediate

SetScale.description: Animate or immediately set a SceneComponent's local scale. Local space only — passing space="world" is an error
SetScale.expects_result_note: Returns as soon as the tween starts when duration_seconds > 0; the undo entry is committed when the animation completes

space.description: Local only — SceneComponent has no world-scale setter, so "world" returns an error

duration_seconds.description: Tween duration in seconds. Defaults to 1.0 (animated); <= 0 = immediate

DuplicateGameObject.description: Duplicate a GameObject and all its components
